British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
April 5th 1940.
9735
Date

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I enclose a copy of a letter from a Mrs.
Clark enquiring as to the present whereabouts of
her son, George Clark, who is stated to have been
in the Police last year.

Can you assist us please as the only person
I can trace in our files is a George William
Clark - last registered in 1935, whose occupation
is given as "Marine Engineer" and his address
16 Studley Avenue, Bayside: I don't think this
is the "missing" son.

Yours sincerely,

R. . Yorke, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

亲爱的约克先生：

随函附上一位克拉克夫人（Mrs. Clark）的来信副本，她询问其子乔治·克拉克（George Clark）目前的下落，据称他去年曾在警务处任职。

能否请您协助我们？我在档案中能查到的唯一人物是乔治·威廉·克拉克（George William Clark），最后登记于1935年，职业注明为“轮机工程师”，地址为贝赛德（Bayside）斯塔德利大道16号（16 Studley Avenue, Bayside）。我认为这不是那位“失踪”的儿子。

此致

敬礼

R. . 约克 先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

Dear Sir,

I hope you will excuse me in taking the
liberty of writing to you concerning my son
George Clark, who was in the Municipal Police
Shanghai, and I have not had any news of him
since last June, I have kept hoping and waiting
and now I feel I can't go any longer without
taking a way to try and find out where he is,
you see my married daughter has had a letter
returned saying he has left, and I was greatly
unset, but none of my letters have returned, you
see I lost my husband in the last war, and George
was only a few months old, and my eldest son is
in the Air Force. So I was thinking you could
help me if you would and let me know if he is
in the same service or back in the Army. He was
in the 2nd Loyal Regt. stationed out there.

Trusting you greatl will try to help me.
Thanking you greatly trusting you will oblige
me and reply by air. I have enclosed air mail
postage.
From Mrs. Clark.

（副本）
（4月3日收悉）
克拉克夫人，
英格兰，
布莱克浦，
马顿，
克罗斯兰路48号。

尊敬的先生：

希望您能原谅我冒昧给您写信，事关我的儿子乔治·克拉克，他曾在上海公共租界警务处任职，自去年六月以来我一直没有他的消息。我一直在盼望和等待，现在我觉得不能再这样等下去了，必须设法查明他的下落。您看，我已婚的女儿收到一封被退回的信，说他已离开，这让我非常不安。但我的信件都没有被退回。您知道，我在上次战争中失去了丈夫，当时乔治只有几个月大，而我的长子正在空军服役。所以我想，如果您愿意的话，能否帮助我，并告知我他是否仍在同一部门服务，或者已回到陆军。他曾隶属于驻扎在那里的第二忠诚团（2nd Loyal Regt.）。

深信您会尽力帮助我。
万分感谢您的帮助，恳请赐复，并请通过航空邮件回复。我已附上航空邮资。
克拉克夫人 谨上

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. 5, Special Branch, Station
REPORT
Date April 11, 1940
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. S. B. D. Date April 11, 1940）
Subject International Health & Beauty Co. - Further
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Supt. Mason

Enquiries show that the name J.P. Baldwin is an alias of one Pao Lung-yun (包龍雲), Cantonese, aged 31, residing at House 10, Lane 1376, Yu Yuen Road, from where he operates the so-called International Health & Beauty Co. He collects mail from P.O. Box 1117 about once per week.

He claims to have successfully graduated in medicine at the Tokio Medical College and to have practised for two years with a Japanese physician in Hongkew, but admits that he has never been registered with the J.M.C.

He attended this office on April 10th when he was asked what was his object in writing the attached letter referring to sex books on sale in the Settlement, to the Police. He claimed that he wished to start up as an agent for books and really wanted an opinion on whether the books mentioned were tolerated in the Settlement. In accordance with previous instructions Pao Lung-yun was informed that no public advertising nor display for sale would be permitted.

Reference the subject of this report, i.e., "Sex" books, and the reference made to the International Book Co., 713/113 Kiukiang Road, it should be stated that there is no connection between Pao Lung-yun alias Baldwin and the International Book Co., nor does there appear any connection, in fact, between Pao Lung-yun and 740 Burkill Road, beyond mere acquaintance.

（印：RECEIVED BY (G.M.) REGISTRY DATE 11 / 4 / 40）

报告
日期：1940年4月11日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 S. B. D. 日期 1940年4月11日）
事由：国际健美公司 - 后续
由 警司戈尔德（D.S.I. Golder）呈报 经 督察长梅森（Supt. Mason）转呈

经查，J.P. 鲍德温（J.P. Baldwin）一名系包龍雲（Pao Lung-yun）之化名，广东人，31岁，居住于愚园路1376弄10号，并从该处经营所谓的“国际健美公司”。他大约每周从邮政信箱1117号取信一次。

他声称自己在东京医学院成功获得医学学位，并在虹口与一名日本医生共同执业两年，但他承认自己从未在江海关医务委员会（J.M.C.）注册。

他于4月10日到访本办公室，当被问及为何就租界内出售的色情书籍一事向警方撰写附件中的信件时，他声称希望开始从事书籍代理业务，并确实想了解上述书籍在租界内是否被容忍。根据先前的指示，已告知包龍雲，不允许进行任何公开广告或陈列销售。

关于本报告的主题，即“色情”书籍，以及信中提及的九江路113号713室国际图书公司（International Book Co.），兹声明：包龍雲（化名鲍德温）与国际图书公司之间并无关联；事实上，除泛泛之交外，包龍雲与伯基尔路740号（740 Burkill Road）之间似乎也无任何关联。

（印：收发室（G.M.）收讫 日期 40/4/11）

SHANGHAI, March 22, 1940

To the Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.
135 Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:

According to police regulations I understand that
bad books, literature and pictures dealing with sex are be-
ing strictly prohibited. This is as it should be. But
books which are really good and educational, which can
easily substitute the bad ones, serve as the "BEST" means
of stamping out evil books. Therefore, I wish to inform
you that the following books are being circulated publicly
abroad and also in Shanghai:

(a) IDEAL MARRIAGE (By VELDE T. H. VAN DE)
(b) SEX TECHNIQUE IN MARRIAGE (By I. G. HUTTON)
(c) SEXUAL BEAUTY OF THE FEMALE FORM

Etc., Etc.

Now that our company are also going to sell books
of the same nature, which are realistic and educational, we
think it is right that we should write to you and obtain
your instructions, so that we may know whether there is any-
thing which we should or should not do when undertaking such
business. We realize that law and order should be upheld,
and business should be done in the proper manner.

Awaiting your reply and instructions,

Very truly yours,

萬 國 健 美 公 司
INTERNATIONAL HEALTH & BEAUTY CO.
簽字 SIGNED _________________________
       經 理 Manager

上海，1940年3月22日

致警察总监，
上海公共租界工部局，
福州路135号，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

根据警务规章，我了解到涉及色情的不良书籍、文献和图片正受到严格禁止。这是理所应当的。但是，那些真正优秀且具有教育意义的书籍，可以轻易取代不良书籍，是根除恶劣书籍的“最佳”手段。因此，我希望通知您，以下书籍正在国外及上海公开流通：

(a) 《理想的婚姻》（作者：VELDE T. H. VAN DE）
(b) 《婚姻中的性技巧》（作者：I. G. HUTTON）
(c) 《女性形体之美》

等等，等等。

鉴于本公司也将销售同类性质的书籍，这些书籍写实且具有教育意义，我们认为应当致函阁下，听取您的指示，以便我们在开展此类业务时知晓何事可为、何事不可为。我们认识到应维护法律与秩序，并以正当方式经营业务。

等候您的回复和指示，

您真诚的，

萬 國 健 美 公 司
INTERNATIONAL HEALTH & BEAUTY CO.
签字 SIGNED _________________________
       经理 Manager

REPORT
Date: April 5, 1940.

Subject International Health & Beauty Co. - Letter to Police re
Sex Books on Sale in the Settlement

Made by D.S.I. Holder Forwarded by Supt. Mason

Reference the attached letter from the
International Health & Beauty Co., P.O. Box 1117,
Shanghai, dated March 22, 1940, on the subject of
"Sex Books" I have to report as follows:-

Nothing is known of the International Health
& Beauty Co. as above, nor of Mr. J.P. Baldwin.
Neither the firm nor the man are listed in the Hong
List nor the telephone directory.

As to subject "A" - "Ideal Marriage" by T.H.
Van de Velde. This publication was offered for sale
by the International Book Co., Room 713, No.113
Kiukiang Road, in circular letters addressed without
discretion through the Post. Some such letters
fell into the hands of juveniles whose parents reported
the matter to the Police.

A pamphlet contained in the letters was
considered indecent and actually comprised an excerpt
from the book "Ideal Marriage." Action was taken
against the proprietor of the International Book Co.
resulting on November 11th, 1939, in his being fined
$150.00. in a judgment given by Judge Te at the First
Special District Court.

Copies of the book and advertising pamphlet
seized under warrant from Room 713, No.113 Kiukiang
Road were ordered confiscated.

Copies of "Ideal Marriage" are still on sale
in the Settlement but are not advertised.

事由：国际健美公司 - 关于租界内出售色情书籍致警方的信

由 警司霍尔德（D.S.I. Holder）呈报 经 督察长梅森（Supt. Mason）转呈

关于附件中来自上海邮政信箱1117号国际健美公司、日期为1940年3月22日、主题为“色情书籍”的信件，现报告如下：

对于上述国际健美公司及J.P. 鲍德温先生，一无所知。该公司及个人均未列入《鸿名册》（Hong List）或电话簿。

关于主题“A”——T.H. Van de Velde所著的《理想的婚姻》。该出版物由九江路113号713室国际图书公司通过邮政 indiscriminately（不加甄别地）寄发的循环信件进行推销。部分此类信件落入青少年手中，其父母向警方报告了此事。

信件中包含的一本小册子被认为有伤风化，实际上 comprised（包含）了《理想的婚姻》一书的摘录。已对国际图书公司的业主采取行动，结果在1939年11月11日，特区第一法院泰法官（Judge Te）判决对其罚款150.00美元。

根据搜查令从九江路113号713室查获的该书及广告小册子副本，已被下令没收。

《理想的婚姻》的副本仍在租界内出售，但未做广告。

在国际图书公司一案及所施加的罚款中，该罚款很大程度上是因为业主选择书中最为恶劣的一页作为广告材料，该摘录除了是对性交 somewhat technical（略带技术性）的描述外，无法作其他解释。

萬 國 健 美 公 司

Shanghai, March 22, 1940

To the Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
185 Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:

According to police regulations I understand that bad books, literature and pictures, dealing with sex, are being strictly prohibited. This is as it should be. But books which are really good and educational, which can easily substitute the bad ones, serve as the "BEST" means of stamping out evil books. Therefore, I wish to inform you that the following books are being circulated publicly abroad and also in Shanghai :-

(a) IDEAL MARRIAGE (By VELDE T. H. VAN DE)
(b) SEX TECHNIQUE IN MARRIAGE (By I. G. HUTTON)
(c) SEXUAL BEAUTY OF THE FEMALE FORM

Etc., Etc.

Now that our company are also going to sell books of the same nature, which are realistic and educational, we think it is right that we should write to you and obtain your instructions, so that we may know whether there is anything which we should or should not do when undertaking such business. We realize that law and order should be upheld, and business should be done in the proper manner.

Awaiting your reply and instructions,

Yours very truly,
萬 國 健 美 公 司
INTERNATIONAL HEALTH & BEAUTY CO.
簽字 SIGNED [签名]
經理 Manager

上海，1940年3月22日

致警察总监，
上海公共租界工部局，
福州路185号，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

根据警务规章，我了解到涉及色情的不良书籍、文献和图片正受到严格禁止。这是理所应当的。但是，那些真正优秀且具有教育意义的书籍，可以轻易取代不良书籍，是根除恶劣书籍的“最佳”手段。因此，我希望通知您，以下书籍正在国外及上海公开流通：

(a) 《理想的婚姻》（作者：VELDE T. H. VAN DE）
(b) 《婚姻中的性技巧》（作者：I. G. HUTTON）
(c) 《女性形体之美》

等等，等等。

鉴于本公司也将销售同类性质的书籍，这些书籍写实且具有教育意义，我们认为应当致函阁下，听取您的指示，以便我们在开展此类业务时知晓何事可为、何事不可为。我们认识到应维护法律与秩序，并以正当方式经营业务。

等候您的回复和指示，

您非常真诚的，
萬 國 健 美 公 司
INTERNATIONAL HEALTH & BEAUTY CO.
签字 SIGNED [签名]
经理 Manager
